memory_candidates.content: When repairing stale line_count entries in a per-extension index-entries.json after editing context files, avoid generate-context-line-counts.sh --write: it rewrites every extension's entries in one pass, risking collateral changes to an extension a concurrent sibling task owns on a shared working tree. Instead, recompute the specific actual counts with `wc -l` and apply a surgical Edit to just the affected entries, then verify narrowly with `generate-context-line-counts.sh --check 2>&1 | grep <extension>`.
